nga 4 zhe/ lngo nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs la bcibs te byon: yar ngo tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung za bsam pa lhun : lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs dug lnga rang rgyud spyod pa'i tshe: de 'dra'i dus na gu ru'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung je bsam pa lhun : hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe:yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o/ rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par sgyu the tshom med:o rgyan pad+ma 'byung za bsam pa lhun : sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe:mi bzod sdug sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na:yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas:che zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung : bsam pa lhun za 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i ji ( ste ri — /4()

ཿ k+ṣe nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom : o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med:o rgyan pad+ma 'byung zabs ma pa lhun jalas can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na:dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gding gis: yid gnyis the tshom med :o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas:pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung : bsam pa lhun ཿ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na:yid gnyis the tshom med 5 o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med:o rgyan pad+ma 'byung :bsam pa lhun : stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom ཿo rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med:o rgyan pad+ma 'byung : bsam pa lhun ཿ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis:sgyu lus g.yar po 'jigs la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom : o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor — ——(༅) /4—

sa /rjo bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung =bsam pa lhun ngu lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i che:bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom : o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: rtsod ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung je bsam pa lhun : gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom : o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung cha bsam pa lhun ca nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom : o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste:bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye:o rgyan pad+ma 'byung :bsam pa lhun :sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do sa 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdu ga bsnga/snyel nyin ri na: yid gnyis the tshom ze o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung cha bsam pa lhun cha gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang byu() ciri 6 rme sa kyi —/48

rgya wa la sno 6 rigyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis the tshom : o rgyan bde chen rgyal pa'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsa da nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'gro drug sdug bsngal chen pos nyen pa dang : khyad par bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na: dad gus mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis: yid gnyis the tshom rme da par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan thugs rjes 'pho 'gyur med par gzigs:o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gso la ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: o rgyan rjes 'jug 'khor ba spong 'dod rnamasaḥrtse gcig gdung bas gdung sems drag po yis: khya'u sa pha mar 'bod 'dra'i gdung dbyangs kyis:nyin mchan dus drug nam byung gsol ba thob: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru rin po che: dngos grub kun bdag bde ba chen po'i zhabs: bar chad kun sel bdud 'dul drag po rtsa la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu wa /༷༷

dre rmirdzi ༄// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bha dra tsar+ya pra ṇi dh+wa na rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'phags nga/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis//rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus par/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /hūṃ —tsho

ཿ jug ā+oṃ/sil snyan rnams dang byug pa'i gdugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar wa —

sgyu smo bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur/ /gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon/ /phyogs bcu ga la'i zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang / /sangs rgyas sras gyis rab tu gang bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang khrub par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing / /sa — — las sa sa pha the sa ri//sta tre ca5 42(/2

sgyu tho khyi 'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra skad ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur/ /sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang / /ji ltar pad+mo chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad/ /zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing / /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun wa du —sku 2()3

par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par gyur/ /bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs pa gang spyod pa/ /de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang / /spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu 'phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung / /sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba lta/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyangs pa yang / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi/ /srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na/ /bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad rnyed/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang / /yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas

nga / rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi/ /de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang / /skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis/ /rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'a༄cog par bgyi/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i chul rnams rab tu bskor ba yis/ /de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang / /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par spyad/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang / /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod wa

///tshe'atshal/ /gang zhig 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan thos nas/ /kha zhe me/da par snying khong rus pa'i gting / /lan gcig tsam zhig dad pa skyes pri na/ /de ni byang chub lam las phyir mi ldog /mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan thos nas/ de ni byang chub snying po rme thob bar/ /bud med mi skye rigs ni bzang rnge ra skye/ /tshe rabs kun tu chul khrims rnam dag 'gyur// bde gshegs 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa ra bcas/ /dngos su 'byor ba'i mchod pa ci mchis pa/ /yid sprul bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun/ /gdod nas grub pa stong gsum 'jig rten gyi/ /gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla bye ba brgya/ /lha klu mi yi longs/ spyod thams cad kun/ /blo yis blangs te 'od dpag med la 'bul/ /bdag la phan phyir thugs rje'i stobs kyis bzhes/ /pha mas thog drangs bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ /srog bcad ma byin blangs dang mi tshangs spyod/ /lus kyi mi dge gsum po mthol lo bshags/ /rdzun dang phra ma chig rtsub ngag 'khyal ba/ /rig gi — wa she zhu ————bye rdo242

ba ( du mchi mi dge bzhi po mtho la lo bshags/ /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste/ /yid kyi mi dge gsum po mthol lo bshags/ /pha ma slob dpon dgra bcom bsad pa dang / /rgyal ba'i sku skol ngan sems skyes pa dang / /mtshams med lnga yi las bsags mthol lo bshags/ /dge slong dge tshul bsad dang btsun ma phab/ /sku gzugs mchod rten lha khang bshig la sogs/ /nye ba'i mcham med sdig byas mthol lo bshags/ /dkon mchog lha khang gsung rab rten gsum sogs/ /dpang zhes tshad btsugs mna' zos la sogs pa/ /chos spangs las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /khams gsum sems can bsad las sdig che ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam la skur ba btab/ /don med sdig chen bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /dge ba'i phan yon sdig pa'i nyes dmigs dang / /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshe chad la sogs pa/ /thos kyang mi bden bshad tshod yin bsam pa/ /mtshams med lnga bas thu ba'i las ngan pa/ /thar med las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum dang / /spang ltung sor bshags nyes byas —— du —sum

ji dga' bas rjes su yi rang na/ /de yi bsod nams mnyam du thob par gsungs/ /de phyir 'phags pa rnams dang so skye yis/ /dge ba gang bsgrubs kun la yi rang ngo / /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /'gro don rgya chen mdzad la yi rang ngo / /mi dge bcu po spangs pa dge ba bcu/ /gzhan gyi srog bskyab sbyin pa gtong ba dang / /sdom pa srung zhing bden par smra ba dang / /'khon pa sdum dang zhi dul drang por smra/ /don dang ldan pa'i gtam brjod 'dod pa chung / /byams dang snying rje sgom zhing chos la spyod/ /dge ba de rnam kun la yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon par/ /de dag rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rgya chen myur du bskor ba bdag gis bskul/ /mngon shes thugs kyis de don mkhyen par gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang sems bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes/ /mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed kun de dag la/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon bdag gi dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /'gro ba sems can kun gyi don du bsngo/ /kun kyang bla

/ / //med byang chub myur thob nas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig /de yi dge ba bdag la myur smin nas/ /tshe 'dir dus mina'achi ba bco brgyad zhi/ /nad med lang tsho rgyas pa'i lus stobs ldan/ /dpal 'byor 'dzad med dbyar gyi gaṅgā ltar/ /bdud dgra'i 'tshe tshob med cing dam chos spyod/ /bsam pa'i don kun chos ldan yid bzhir 'grub/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan thogs rgya chen 'grub/ /mi lus don dang ldan par 'grub par shog /bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs kun/ /'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /dge slong dge 'dun 'khor gyis bskor/ /mdun du mngon sum 'byon par shog /de mthong yid dga' snang ba skyid/ /shi ba'i sdus bsngal med par shog /byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad ni/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis nam mkhar byon/ /bde ba can du 'gro ba yi / /la dru ston lam sna 'dren par shog /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod blag med/ /lha mi'i bde skyid mi rtag 'gyur/ /de la skrag sems skye bar shog /thos — — —ri sa/waX tsho ge246

/ / sna ji cim mi de nas da lta'i bar/ /'khor ba 'di na yun re ring / /de la skyo ba skye bar shog /mi nas mi ru skye chog kyang / /skye rga na 'chi grangs med myong / /dus ngan snyigs mar bar chad mang / /mi dang lha yi bde skyid 'di/ /dug dang 'dres pa'i zas bzhin du/ /'dod pa spu tsam med par shog /nye du zas nor mthun grogs rnams/ /mi rtag sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /chags zhen spu tsam med par shog /sa cha yul ris khang khyim rnams/ /rmi lam yul gyi khang khyim ltar/ /bden par ma grub shes par shog /thar med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas/ /nyes chen btson nas thar pa bzhin/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /phyi ltas med par 'bros par shog /chags zhen 'khri ba kun bcad nas/ /bya rgod rnyi nas thar ba bzhin/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la/ /'jig rten khams ni grangs med pa/ /skad cig yud la bgrod bya nas/ /bde ba can du phyin par shog /de ru sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /mngon sum bzhugs pa'i zhal mthong nas/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag par shog /skye gnas bzhi yi mchog gyur pa/ /me tog pad+ma'i snying po la/ /brdzus te skye ba len par shog /ska cig nyid la lus rdzogs ri(༷) — — — — ——4 24la

/skyi:ji ci rdo/ byu nas/ /mchan dpe ldan pa'i lus thob shog /mi skye dogs pa'i the tshom gyis/ /lo grangs lnga brgya'i bar dag tu/ /nang der bde skyid longs spyod ldan/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni thos na yang / /me tog kha ni mi bye bas/ /sangs rgyas zhal mjal phyi ba'i skyon/ /de 'dra bdag la mi 'byung shog /skyes ma thag tu me tog bye/ /'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong shog /bsod nams stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /lag pa'i mthil nas mchod pa'i sprin/ /bsam mi khyab par spros byas nas/ /sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mchod par shog /de tshe de bzhin gshegs pa des/ /phyag g.yas brkyangs nas mgo la bzhag /byang chub lung bstan thob par shog /zab dang rgya che'i chos thos nas/ /rang rgyud smin cing grol bar shog /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob/ /rgyal sras thu bo rnam / gnyis kyis/ /byin gyi brlabs shing rjes bzung shog /nyin re bzhin du phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med pa/ /'od dpag med pa mchod pa dang / /zhing der blta phyir yon pa'i tshe/ /de dag kun la bsnyen ba kur zhing / /chos kyi bdud rtsi thob par shog /rdzu 'phrul/ pya434 ri

/ / ji yas 'od dpag med/ /che dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das/ /gang zhig khyed kyi mtshan ni sus 'jin pa/ /sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin ma gtogs pa/ /me chu dug mtshon gnod sbyin srin po sogs/ /'jigs pa kun las skyob par thub pas gsungs/ /bdag ni khyed kyi mtshan 'dzin phyag 'tshal bas/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun las bskyab mdzad gsol/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar smon lam btab bzhin 'grub par shog /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta du thu/ pa ༷ sgri ya ā wa bo khyu na ye swāhā/ smon lam 'grub pa'i gzungs so// dkon mchosagasum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo mañdzu shri ye/ na mo su shri ye/ na mo ཿutā ma shri ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas phyag gsum mtshal na 'bum ther du 'gyur bsna gsungs/ de nas rab brgya phrag /'bring ci nus/ tha ma yang phyag bdun yan 'cha dag /rab 'di ma chag pa/ 'bring lo zla tsam ma chag pa/ tha ma nam khom skabs su kha nub bye —— —— cirngo 7 ————4 — 234

sgro rje 4rdzi 'phrad par mi 'gyur ba'i rgyur cha bslab pa gsum la mi slob cing rgyal ba'i gsung rab la thos bsam 'gog pa'i grogs sdudang mi 'grogs pa'i za sangs rgyas pa'i thabs gzhan ston rgyu med par shes pa'i rang ngo bltas tsam gyis chog shes 'dzin pa de 'dra ba'i rigs rtag tu mi mthong ba'i: rang nyid sa lam mthon po yin snyam pa'i blo 'chang nas mi dge ba byed pa'i go 'phang mi thob pa'i: rgyal ba'i gsung rab nas 'byung ba'i sdom gsum gyi go mi chod kyang rang sar blos dpyad nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa yin par rloms nas lus gdung bar mi byed pa'i: gzhan ngo tshe 'dir chags nas thos pa sogs la 'bungs kyang lag len khyim pa bas dman par mi byed pa'i: tshe 'dir sdig pa la 'bad nas yin par bstan pa yin par mi mos pa'iḥ rang gi rgyud la sdom pa sna re tsam yang med kyang dad zas len pa'i chos par mi skye ba'i: sdig rang gis byed nas khag gzhan la 'gel ba sogs g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa mi byed ba'i: rang chos dang mi mthun par shes kyang da dung gzhan 'khrul du 'jug nas rang skyon sbed par byed pa la dga' ba'i blo mi skye ba'i: tshe stong zad du song ba la sdug du/——ci zi de nga/

/ sa / sgo bsngal med par snam bu kha dog dang tshos ma legs pa tsam la sdug bsngal zhag skor re mi skye ba'i: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang yongs 'dzin dam pa mjal nas chos byed pa la dga' spro med par gos bzang 'byor pa re byung na dga' ba la bsam pa'i dga' ba go log mi 'byung ba'i: skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan dang rnam thar mngon sum la mi dad par rdzun ma gzhan mgo bskor ba'i lkog gyur gyi yon tan yod zer ba'i rjes su mi 'jug pa'i: tshig gi phyi mo tsam yang mi shes par gzhan grol ba la sbyor ba skad zer ba'i chos pa la yid mi rton pa'i: gsung rab dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa byed kyang da dung phyogs ris kyi dbang gis 'di dgos ldan gyi mdzad pa khyad par can yin snyam pa'i blo mi skye ba'i: mdor na mdo rgyud nas bla ma'i yon tan bshad pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma yongs 'dzin zhu ba'i: de la mdo rgyud nas bshad pa'i dad pa zol med skye ba'i: de'i drung der mdo rgyud nas bshad pa'i byang chung kyi sems bzung ba'i: de bzung nas rgyal ba'i bka' las byung ba'i lam bsgom pa'i rgyur: lam de la gegs med par rim bzhin sa bcu bgrod de 'chi med kyi go 'phang — ()—

/ / ste / lam ni ston pa po/ /don grub bsam pa 'grub pa ste/ /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad/ /chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes/ /bsod nams ldan pa bsod nams tshogs/ /ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/ /ye shes ldan pa yod med shes/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po/ /rtag pa kun rgyal rnal 'byor can/ /bsam gtan bsam bya blo ldan bdag /so so rang rig mi g.yo ba/ /mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang / /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can/ /spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang / /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa po/ /sangs rgyas sras po dam nga/'i mchog /shes pa srid 'byung skye gnas med/ /chos las 'byung ba srid pa sel/ /gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i bdag /skyes ma thag tu 'gro ba'i bdag /nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /shes rab ye shes me bo che/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba/ /sngags mchog sngags bdag rig sngags rgyal/ /du — — mi nga nga(18

sgyu zla:khyi/ gsang sngags rgyal po don chen byed/ /gtsug tor chen po med byung gtsug/nam mkha'i bdag po sna tshogs ston/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag dngos po mchog /'gro kun dga' ba'i mig dang ldan/ /sna tshogs gzugs can skyed pa po/ /mchod cing rjed pa drang srong che/ /rig gsum 'chang ba gsang sngags 'chang / /dam tshig chen po gsang sngags 'dzin/ /gtso bo dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa/ /theg pa mchog gsum ston pa po/ /don yod zhags pa rnam par rgyal/ /'dzin pa chen po rdo rje zhags/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi tshigs bcad rkang pas dman pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ /keng rus mche ba gtsigs pa po/ /ha lā ha lā gdong brgya pa/ /gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /rdo rje shugs can 'jigs byed pa/ /rdo rje drag po rdo rje'i snying / /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ /rdo rje las skyes rdo rje'i bdag /rdo rje'i snying po mkha' 'dra ba/ /mi g.yo ral pa gcig gis bsgyings/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /drag chen hā hā —— du snyo — de(〉(

〈zlo:smyu zhes sgrogs pa/ /hi hi zhes sgrogs 'jigs par byed/ /gad mo chen po gad rgyangs can/ /rdo rje gad mo cher sgrogs pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje rgyal po bde ba che/ /rdo rje drag po dga' ba che/ /rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūm̐ zhes sgrogs/ /mtshon du rdo rje'i mda' thogs pa/ /rdo rje ral gris ma lus gcod/ /rdo rje kun 'chang rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gcig pu g.yul sel ba/ /rdo rje 'bar ba mig mi bzang / /skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa 'bebs pa che/ /mig brgya pa ste rdo rje'i mig /lus ni rdo rje'i ba spu can/ /rdo rje'i spu ni gcig pu'i lus/ /sen mo skyes pa rdo rje'i rtse/ /rdo rje snying po pags pa mkhregs/ /rdo rje'i 'phreng thogs dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /gad rgyangs hā hā nges par sgrogs/ /yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra/ /'jam dbyangs chen po'i sgra che ba/ /'jig rten gsum na sgra gcig pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas sgra sgrogs pa/ /sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog /me long ye shes kyi tshig bcadarkang pa dang bcas pa bcu'o// yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /yang das mtha' ste yi ge med/ /stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /zab cing rgya che'idu—ri —/ /

ji ji /lha tho sgra sgrogs pa/ /chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan/ /chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi sgra bo che/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa po/ /phyogs bcu'i chos kyi rnga bo che/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid las skyes//gzugs rnams thams cad snang ba'i dpal/ /gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba po/ /tshugs pa med cing che bar grags/ /khams gsum dbang phyug chen po ste/ /'phaḍa lam shin tu mtho la gnas/ /dar ba chen po chos kyi tog /'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /gnas brtan rgan po skye rgu'i bdag /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /sdug gu 'jig rten gsum na mdzes/ /'jig rten shes legs slob dpon te// 'jig rten slob dpon 'jigs pa med/ /mgon skyob 'jig rten yid gcugs pa/ /skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas longs spyod pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtsho/ /ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa/ /srid pa'i drwa ba 'joms pa po/ /nyon mongs ma lus zhi byed pa/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs/ /sdug tsho

/ / sgro bsngal gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi/ /gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob/ /sgrib pa kun las nges par grol/ /mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun las 'das/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po/ /sems can kun gyi klu chen po/ /yon tan thod can rnams kyi thod/ /nyon mongs kun las rnam grol ba/ /nam mkha'i lam la rab gnas pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /khyab bdag rin chen kun gyi bdag /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ste/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /byed pa sems can kun don byed/ /phan 'dod sems can mnyes gshin pa/ /bzang ngan shes shing dus shes la/ /khyab bdag dam shes dam tshig ldan/ /dus shes sems can dbang po shes/ /rnam grol gsum la mkhas pa po/ /yon tan ldan zhing yon tan shes/ /chos shes bkra shis bkra shis 'byung / /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /dbugs 'byin chen po dag khu rīston che/ /dga' chen rol mo chen po ste/ /bkur sti rim gro phun su rdzu tshogs/ /mchog tu dga' ba grags bdag dpal/ /mchog ldan snom chang dasaci ji sto gi tre —— —mo / 372

/ ste lha sgyumi sbyin gtso bo ste/ /skyabs kyi dam pa skyabs su 'os/ /'jig rten dgra ste rab kyi mchog /'jigs pa ma lus sel ba po/ /gtsug phud phud bu lcang lo can/ /ral pa muñdza cod pan thogs/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ /zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /mgo zlum brtul zhugs chen po ste/ /tshangs par spyod pa brtul zhugs mchog /dka' thub mthar phyin dka' thub che/ /gtsang gnas dam pa spyo ta ma/ /bram ze tshangs pa tshangs pa shes/ /mya ngan 'das pa tshangs pa thob/ /grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus/ /rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba nyid/ /mya ngan 'das zhi mya ngan 'das/ /legs par mya ngan 'das dang nye/ /bde sdug sel ba mthar gyur pa/ /chags bral lus las 'das pa po/ /thub pa med pa dpe med pa/ /mi mngon mi snang gsal byed min/ / cha med kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /phra zhing zag med sa bon bral/ /rdul med rdul bral dri ma med/ /nyes pa spangs pa skyon med pa/ /shin tu sad pa sad pa'i bdag /kun shes kun rig dam pa po/ /rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das/ /ye shes gnyis med chul 'chang ba/ /rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /dus gsum — du kai

/ rje — — rgyas kun gyi bstan pa gcig /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur dpal/ /rin chen kun bdag dbang phyug ste/ /'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin/ /rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /chags bral dang po chags pa che/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i chos 'dzin pa/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes// kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rgyal po sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs 'chang / /che ba sangs rgyas rig sngags 'chang / /rdo rje rnon po ral gri che/ /yi ge mchog ste rnam par dag /theg pa chen po sdug bsngal gcod// mtshon cha chen po rdo rje chos/ /rdo rje zab mo dzi na jig /rdo rje blo gros don bzhin rig /pha rol phyin pa kun rdzo gas pa/ /sa rnams kun gyi rgyan dang ldan/ /rnam par dag pa bdag me/da chos/ /yang dag ye shes zla 'od bzang / /brtso na chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste/ /rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po —— pyi chi — ci

ri ciX yirtswa mchog /rdo rje'i gdan ni ma lus /ldan/ /ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang / /kun tu bzang po blo gros bzang / /sa yi snying jo/ 'gro ba 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po che/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'jin/ /skye med chos de sna tshogs don / /chos kun ngo bo nyid 'chang ba/ /shes rab chen pos skad cig la/ /chos kun khong du chud pa 'chang / /chos kun mngon par rtogs pa ste/ /thub pa blo mchog 'byung ba'i mtha'/ /mi g.yo rab tu dang ba'i bdag /rdzogs nga/'i sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi mngon sum pa/ /ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /so sor gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi chogs su bcad pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis so/ /'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /ngan song thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po sems can kun gyi mchog /sems can thams cad rab grol byed/ /nyon mongs g.yul du gcig dpa' ba/ /mi shes dgra yi dregs pa 'joms/ /blo ldan sgeg 'chang dpal dang ldan//brtan po mi sdug gzugs 'chang ba/ /lag pa brgya po kun bskyod cing //(༄74

/// gom pa'i stabs kyis gar byed pa/ /dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la//nam mkha' khyab par gar byed nga// /sa yi dkyil 'khor bzhi yi khyon//rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon/ /rkang mtheb sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang / /changs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon/ /don gcig gnyis med chos kyi don/ /dam pa'i don ni 'jig pa med/ /rnam rig sna tshogs gzugs don can/ /sems dang rnam shes rgyud dang ldan/ /dngos don ma lus rnams la dga'/ /stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags sogs spangs pa/ /srid gsum dga' ba chen po pa/ /sprin dkar dag pa bzhin du dkar/ /'od bzang ston ga'i zla ba'i 'od/ /nyi ma 'char ga'i dkyil ltar mjes/ /sen mo'i 'od ni shas cher dmar/ /cod pan bzang po mthon da'i rtse / /skra mchog mthon ka chen po 'chang / /nor bu chen po 'od chags dpal/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /'jig rten khams brgya kun bskyed pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i stobs chen ldan/ /de nyid dran pa chen po 'chang / /dran pa bzhi po ting 'jin rgyal/ /byang chub yan snyel ga me tog spos/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i —— —

lha::ji / /yon tan mtsho/ /lam gyi yan lag brgyad chu'/ rig /yang dag sangs rgyas lam rig pa/ /sems can kun la shas cher chags/ /nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med/ /sems can kun gyi yid la 'jug /sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs/ /sems can kun gyi dbang don shes/ /sems can kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /phung po lnga don de nyid shes/ /rnam dag phung po lnga 'chang ba/ /nges 'byung kun gyi mtha' la gnas/ /nges par 'byung ba kun la mkhas/ /nges 'byung kun gyi lam la gnas/ /nges par 'byung ba kun ston pa/ /yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton/ /dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang / /bden bzhi'i tshul gyi rnam pa can/ /shes pa brgyad po rtogs pa 'chang / /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ /rnam pa sangs rgyas kun rig mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa po/ /skad cig thams cad mngon par rtogs/ /sems kyi skad cig don kun rig /theg pa sna tshogs thabs chul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la rtogs pa po/ /theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig () ci nga trege 378

sa ci gi 'bras bur gnas/ /nyon mongs /bams rnams dag pa'i bdag /las kyi khams rnams zad byed pa/ /chu bo rgya mtsho kun skolas brgal/ /sbyor ba'i dgon pa las byung ba/ /nyon mongs nye ba kun nyon mongs/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa/ /snying rje che dang shes rab thabs/ /don yod 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /'du shes kun gyi don spangs shing / /rnam shes don ni 'gog par byed/ /sems can kun yid yul dang ldan/ /sems can kun gyi yid rig pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /de dag se/mas dang mthun par 'jug /sems can kun yid tshim par byed/ / sems can kun gyi yid dga' ba/ /grub pa mthar phyin 'khrul pa med/ /nor ba thams cad rnam par spangs/ /don gsum the tshom med pa'i blo/ /kun don yon tan gsum gyi bdag /phung po lnga don dus gsum du/ /skad cig thams cad bye brag phyed/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'chang / /lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /lus kyi mtha' ni rtogs pa po/ /—— —tshoX
